For a 1,000Wh portable power station, I recommend 300–400W of solar panels for a practical full recharge in one day of decent sunlight.

The exact wattage depends on your location, season, and how quickly you want to recharge.

Before you buy

Check the solar input limit: A station limited to 200W won't charge faster just because you connect 400W of panels.

Check voltage and connectors: The recommended panel has a 37.4V working voltage and 45.3V open-circuit voltage.

Account for winter: Shorter days and weaker sunlight may mean you need more than 400W of panels or multiple days to recharge.

My recommendation: Start with 300W for a budget-conscious setup or 400W for faster charging. For a more precise recommendation, the most important detail is your power station's brand and model.
